characters.name: Art
characters.miniBio: There once was a girl with deep pockets, Full of acorns and string and old lockets. She'd count them by name, Each evening the same, Then sleep with them tucked in their sockets.

characters.name: Azrael
characters.miniBio:
I met a young man who was fond of all doors.
Walls were just separators, and so were the floors.
Though death was his title,
His duties were vital.
He just never quite knew what the fuss was all for.

characters.name: Qismat
characters.miniBio:
There once was a kid who played everything straight.
He knew that his destiny was up for debate.
He saw every twist
Yet refused to resist
For he know it was all up to fate.

characters.name: Zaman
characters.miniBio:
I once met a kid who was truly sublime.
He saw every tick, and he heard every chime.
The clock on the wall
Meant nothing at all
Cause he never learned how to tell time.
characters.shortBio:
His name is Zaman. Or ZAH-mahn if you want to be Arabic about it.

Sun dials? Clocks? Watches? He never had a need. And between me and you, he can't read them anyway.

Zaman is the kid who knows the secret everyone else is trying to figure out - Time is an illusion. The present moment is right now, and it's exactly where you need to be.

You're not late. You're making an entrance.

You can't "run out of time". Why hurry? You'll get there eventually.

Seeds don't stress about becoming trees.

Sunsets don't apologize for taking their time.

Now is NOT a four letter word.

Relax.

You've got Time.

If he could just figure out what to do about the guy who keeps opening and closing his doors...

characters.name: Alyan
characters.miniBio:
I once met a boy who went to extremes.
His wings resembled gossamer streams.
My secrets he'd keep.
For it was only in sleep,
He'd visit my nightmares and dreams.

characters.name: Desiree
characters.miniBio:
I met a girl whose hair was like fire.
Her presence alone could make you fly higher.
On affairs of the heart,
She could not tell them apart.
She only knew want and desire.

characters.name: Gelilah
characters.miniBio:
I once met a they who was a true extrovert.
Their brazen advances were hard to avert.
For you have to remember
That no matter the gender,
Everyone loves a good flirt.

characters.name: Tripp
characters.miniBio:
I met a boy whose moral compass was just.
Who viewed sitting still with signs of disgust.
Armed with a map and a chart,
He considered travel as art.
For nothing could satiate his wanderlust.
